name: CWAA Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Crowned by a 16-man tournament in the fed's own first two months, the CWAA's top title changed hands three more times -- twice by decision, once by unmasking -- before the held record ends with its reigning champion revealed as Marc Thomas.

name: CWAA Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Crowned by an eight-team tournament, lost to a steel-cage upset, and reclaimed in August by the fed's own first-ever two-time champions.

name: CWAA Television Championship
epitaph: Won in a 12-man battle royal and defended by the fed's own house rule every single week thereafter, the Television title changed hands four times across the held record.

name: CWAA Six Man Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Created for the CWAA's own Supershow, decided by a single-elimination tournament on the promotion's biggest card of the year.
